title: martijnvanbrummelen/nwipe
quotes: It was created to run the DBAN erase engine on any Linux distribution, with better and more modern hardware support.
> Both `hdparm` and `smartmontools` are **mandatory** if you want all nwipe features to be fully available.
> If they are not installed **at runtime**, nwipe will log a warning and continue, but many important features will not work as intended.
limitations: GPL-2.0 许可；仅负责硬盘级擦除与报告生成，不含估价、财务与手机端逻辑。
why_selected: 开源 Linux 磁盘数据擦除核心引擎（支持 DoD/NIST 方法并输出 PDF 擦除审计证书）

title: PartialVolume/shredos.x86_64
quotes:

title: Seagate/openSeaChest
quotes:
# openSeaChest

## Cross platform storage device utilities to manage, configure, and read health information for SATA, SAS, NVMe, and USB attached HDDs and SSDs.
openSeaChest is your storage device expert - a collection of **18 task-focused utilities** covering **200+ commands** so you don't need to be a low-level command expert.
openSeaChest provides a **task-focused, cross-platform approach** to storage device management.
limitations: MPL-2.0 许可；偏底层存储硬件诊断与安全擦除 CLI，需二次封装成收货质检流水线。
why_selected: 希捷开源跨厂商磁盘诊断与底层安全擦除工具集（支持 SMART 体检、SATA/NVMe/SAS 底层指令）

title: libimobiledevice/libimobiledevice
quotes:
Unlike other projects, it does not depend on using any existing proprietary
libraries and does not require jailbreaking.

The library is in development since August 2007 with the goal to bring support
for these devices to the Linux Desktop.

Optionally,
`mbedtls_LIBS` can be used to set the library names directly.

why_selected: 跨平台开源 iOS 设备通信与诊断底层协议库（无需 iTunes 读取电池循环、设备信息与状态）
